proposals.explanation: EnhancedModeProperties initializes its nullable backing flag to true and exposes it through an internal get/set Enabled property. This establishes a local model default, not a guarantee about service activation.

proposals.subtype: Force the enhanced-mode enable field when configuration is defined
proposals.explanation: The custom JSON writer writes enabled=true when Optional.IsDefined reports Task or TargetLanguage, or Optional.IsCollectionDefined reports Prompt. Otherwise it writes Enabled only when defined. This branch takes precedence over an explicit false Enabled value when its configuration predicate is true; the imported Optional predicate implementations are not supplied.

proposals.subtype: URI and stream input constructors sharing collection initialization
